sourceFaceMap.method: Independent fixed-camera visible-surface face-ID traces, asymmetric hanging-side/opposite crest; enclosed source-surface gaps filled; disconnected islands and seam tips removed. No mirror, remesh, caps, or added geometry.

comparison.note: Historical faces map against pre-sole family geometry; corrected faces map against a separately generated forward sole-support transform. Both require three unique nearest source vertices within 5 micrometers; ambiguous/unmatched faces remain unmapped.
